## Preparing the exam

**Template**: <https://github.com/fs-ise/exam-template>

```bash
cd ~/Nextcloud/teaching/exams/YYYY_SEM
uvx copier copy gh:fs-ise/exam-template path_to_new-exam
cd path_to_new-exam
make setup
make exams
```

- Exam dates: <pruefungsorganisation@fs.de>
- View examination dates in TimeEdit: Log in to TimeEdit as a staff member. Then either open **All Room Bookings** or use the **Examination Schedule** (set the date in the header and search for the relevant exam).
- Submit the exam as a PDF document at least two weeks before the examination date.
- Include sufficient space for students to provide their answers.
- Arrange a review by colleagues for large courses (e.g., Introduction to Programming); prefer sequential over parallel feedback.

::: {.callout-important title="Checklist"}
- Use a Git repository during development. Once the exam is finalized and archived, remove the `.git` directory.
- Consider `Nextcloud/teaching/exams/materials/*` for new tasks/ideas.
- Do not reuse old exams.
  Students have access to a large Dropbox folder containing previous exams.
- Use a sandboxed AI to check for errors and potential misunderstandings.

See `Nextcloud/exams/checklist.md` for additional items.

:::

## Grading

- Exato: Link shared by the Examination Office.
- Grading deadline: Three weeks (including the Christmas period), interpreted as 15 working days.
- Grading can be completed digitally or on paper.
- Group work graded in Canvas: Send an email to <pruefungsorganisation@fs.de>, asking the Examination Office to run the grade transfer.
- Check the grade distribution: [Faculty manual](https://nc-2272638881871040784.nextcloud-ionos.com/index.php/apps/files/files/1728329?dir=/management/compliance&openfile=true){target=_blank}.

## Review and solutions

PO sends an email with subject "Solution for upcoming review session".

- Publishing solutions is not necessary if the grading comments are detailed enough.
- For *Introduction to Programming*, solutions are usually provided.
